data.task_title: Create Artemis self-demo with Chart.js visualization

features.title: Display Real-Time Metrics Dashboard
features.description: Create a real-time dashboard using Chart.js to display LLM cost over time, stage completion rates, and success rate trends.
acceptance_criteria: LLM cost over time is shown with a line chart
Stage completion rates are displayed with a bar chart
Success rate trends are visualized with an area chart

features.title: Showcase Artemis Features
features.description: Highlight key features of Artemis including cost tracking, sandboxing, and learning with metrics displayed using charts.
acceptance_criteria: Cost tracking feature is demonstrated with charts
Sandboxing and learning features are highlighted
Charts accurately represent feature metrics

features.title: Implement Chart.js Visualizations
features.description: Use Chart.js to create various data visualizations such as pipeline metrics, cost tracking, and success rates.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline metrics are visualized using Chart.js
Cost tracking is displayed with appropriate charts
Success rates are shown using Chart.js visualizations

features.title: Present Real Metrics from Recent Runs
features.description: Include actual data from recent runs to showcase Artemis' performance and results.
acceptance_criteria: Real metrics are included in the presentation
Data is accurate and up-to-date
Metrics are presented in a clear and understandable format

features.title: Create Standalone HTML Presentation
features.description: Develop a single HTML file that includes embedded CSS, JavaScript, and Chart.js for data visualization.
acceptance_criteria: HTML file is standalone with no external dependencies
CSS and JavaScript are embedded within the HTML file
Chart.js is included for data visualization

features.title: Demonstrate Code Quality Metrics
features.description: Use a radar chart to display TDD compliance and adherence to SOLID principles.
acceptance_criteria: TDD compliance is shown on a radar chart
SOLID principles adherence is visualized
Chart accurately reflects code quality metrics

features.title: Integrate Supervisor Across Stages
features.description: Visualize supervisor integration across different stages using a pie chart.
acceptance_criteria: Supervisor integration is clearly shown with a pie chart
Chart accurately reflects integration data
Visualization is clear and easy to understand

features.title: Auto-Advance Slides with Navigation Controls
features.description: Enable slides to auto-advance with the option for manual navigation controls.
acceptance_criteria: Slides auto-advance after a set duration
Users can manually navigate through slides
Navigation controls are intuitive and responsive

features.title: Design Professional Presentation
features.description: Incorporate a professional gradient background and smooth transitions into the presentation.
acceptance_criteria: Presentation includes a gradient background
Transitions between slides are smooth
Overall design is professional and visually appealing
